module: ImGui drawing (via the draw list) of the finish time distribution preview in the rally editor's "AI Competitors" tab. drawFinishTimeChart draws the grid, the axes, one curve per outcome (first 4 weighted outcomes) and the highlighted mixture curve; drawOutcomeShareRow displays the share (%) of each outcome in columns. The data comes from aiCompetitorsEditorPreview.computeVisualization.
notes: The curve for outcome 5 (DNF) is not drawn: only outcomes 1 to 4 have a density curve (DNF has no finish time).
The chart is 300 px high, with 20 horizontal and 10 vertical divisions; if the plot area is less than 48 px, the text chartCopy.plotTooSmall is displayed instead.
Colors: blue 58a6ff, orange ffa657, green 3fb950, red f85149, gray 8b949e; the mixture is bluish white f0f6fc.

outcomeLineColors.desc: Colors of the 5 outcomes (Safe, Push, Minor, Major, DNF), reusable for labels.

drawOutcomeShareRow.desc: Displays on a numOutcomes-column row the colored label of each outcome and its percentage (100 × visualization.weights[i], 2 decimals).

drawFinishTimeChart.desc: Reserves an area (available width x 300 px), draws the grid, axes graduated in seconds (density on the y axis), the weighted curves of outcomes 1 to 4 (line 1.2) and the mixture curve (line 2.4), all clipped to the plot area.

visualization.desc: Result of computeVisualization: density.mixture, weightedComponents, yMax, timeLo, timeHi.
